messages:
raj: Hey — opened PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321|infra#4321> to make NAT gateways per-AZ and enable route propagation for gpu subnets. Can someone take a quick look? I included the plan below.

infra-bot: CI: terraform plan OK, tfsec passed. cost-check flagged an increase in EIP count (+3).

lina: :eyes: I'll take a pass in ~20m. Quick Q: are we introducing any cross-AZ routing changes that could affect latency?

sophie: On it — from a quick skim route_propagation looks OK. One operational question: will this require a restart/recreate of any instances in the GPU pools? If so we should coordinate with oncall.

michael: Also, FYI we usually run NAT per-AZ for GPU pools to avoid cross-AZ egress charges, so this change aligns with that. Can you add a short note in modules/nat/README about cost tradeoffs? :+1:

raj: Thanks. I'll add the README note. Plan snippet below (trimmed):

```
Terraform will perform the following actions:

  # module.nat.aws_eip.egress[0] will be created
  + resource "aws_eip" "egress" {
      + id = (known after apply)
      + vpc = true
      ...
    }
  # module.nat.aws_eip.egress[1] will be created
  # module.nat.aws_eip.egress[2] will be created

Plan: 3 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.
```

lina: Thanks — can you also add a var like `nat_per_az` so customers can opt out (single NAT) for cost-sensitive envs?

raj: Good call. Added `variable "nat_per_az" { type = bool default = true }` and pushed a small update to the PR branch `raj/nat-per-az`.

infra-bot: PR checks passed on branch raj/nat-per-az (plan cached) :white_check_mark:

sophie: LGTM from networking side, leaving approval after docs update is committed.

michael: approved — @raj merge when ready. suggest waiting ~30m for any late CI flakes.

raj: Will merge in ~30m unless anyone requests more time. Thanks all :rocket:
